thread:
Maria D.: Heads up — I'm pushing an attn_surgeon change that switches to the fused_v2 kernel. Can someone run a quick KV-slab end-to-end bench on an A100? Need seq=4096, batch=1, quant=8. @aj @samir
Aj Patel: I can take it but the GPU queue is full until ~11:30 PT. Do you have the exact bench command and model tag?
Maria D.: Yep — use `./bench/run_attn.sh --model gpt-j-kv-slab --seq 4096 --batch 1 --kernel fused_v2 --quant 8 --runs 3` — logs to `/tmp/attn-v2.log`. Also please keep the run id in the PR comments.
Samir K.: I grabbed a slot and queued it on a100-3. Starting now. Will post a short perf summary when done.
bench-bot: Job 8803 queued on a100-3 by Samir K. Estimated start: 12m. link: https://ci.internal/bench/8803
Olga V.: Quick code-review pls when you have a sec — PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/1234. Major change in `attn_kernel.cu` + selector logic. Watch kv eviction guard.
Kai L.: Did a small smoke locally on devbox (not A100). Quick numbers: median latency up ~6%, p95 up ~12% with fused_v2. Snippet:
```
model: gpt-j-kv-slab  kernel: fused_v2  seq:4096  bsz:1
median: 82ms -> 87ms (+6%)
p95:   110ms -> 123ms (+12%)
```
Maria D.: Ugh. I was expecting a small win for long seqs. Samir — any sign from the full run?
Samir K.: Full run finished. 3 runs avg token/s: 64.2 vs mainline 72.9 — that's ~12% throughput regression. Trace uploaded: `/tmp/attn-v2.log`. I'll attach nvprof next.
Maria D.: Can you re-run with NVTX markers + `export CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` and `NVTX=1` in env, also try `--kernel fused_v1` for comparison? Need nvprof/nvtx traces to see where kernels are stalling.
Aj Patel: I'll flip the runtime kernel selector to force fused_v1 for a control run tomorrow morning and re-bench across 3 p95 runs. For now mark the PR as draft and add `perf/regression` label.
Olga V.: I'll leave a review comment requesting a fallback policy in the selector and an assert if kv-state exceeds threshold. Adding review now :thumbsup:
bench-bot: Job 8841 finished. artifacts: https://ci.internal/bench/8841/logs
Maria D.: Thanks everyone. I'll update INF-452 with these numbers and next steps (re-run with NVTX, compare v1/v2, add fallback). If regression persists we'll rollback the kernel change.
Kai L.: FYI I can help interpret nvprof traces tomorrow. Ping me when they're uploaded.
Maria D.: Will do — thanks!
